contracts.name: Mad Sheep
contracts.hint: Sheep on the plateau. Stay clear of rams and elementals.

contracts.name: Sand Hare
contracts.hint: Rabbits in the dunes; begin from the H-7 outpost.

contracts.name: Snipper
contracts.hint: Crabs along the beaches; watch nearby goblins.

contracts.name: Land Worm
contracts.hint: Worms on the open island. Use the F-6 outpost as your starting point.

contracts.name: Clipper
contracts.hint: Crabs on the open island, outside the F-6 tower/outpost area.

contracts.name: Giant Spider
contracts.hint: Eastern desert. Watch for linking spiders and anticans.

contracts.name: Sand Beetle
contracts.hint: Sand beetles in the open desert; pull one at a time.

contracts.name: Worker Crawler
contracts.hint: First crawler rooms from the entrance; avoid deeper high-level sections.

contracts.name: Desert Spider
contracts.hint: Spiders in the open desert; avoid anticans and manticores.

contracts.name: Robber Crab
contracts.hint: Crabs on the entrance map. Watch for Guivre and other NMs.

contracts.name: Robber Crab
contracts.hint: Lower crab areas; avoid the named crab Aquarius.

contracts.name: Damselfly
contracts.hint: Flies in the dunes can link. Pull away from other flies.

contracts.name: Giant Ranger
contracts.hint: Gigas on the open island. Prepare Trusts and avoid links.

contracts.name: Desert Dhalmel
contracts.hint: Dhalmels in the desert can link. Pull one at a time.

contracts.name: Soldier Crawler
contracts.hint: Past the first rooms. Take care around linking crawlers.

contracts.name: Steelshell
contracts.hint: Upper crab areas. Bring a prepared party or Trust team.

routes.name: Valkurm Coast
routes.hint: Stay in Valkurm Dunes. Approach each entrance; you do not need to enter it.

routes.name: Qufim Watch
routes.hint: Stay in Qufim Island. Travel by day and prepare Sneak/Invisible where needed.

nms.name: Valkurm Emperor
nms.hint: Defeat the Damselfly placeholder around E-9; this NM is a lottery spawn. The drop is not guaranteed.

nms.name: Trickster Kinetix
nms.hint: Native lottery NM. Hunt Dancing Weapons; this is a longer optional goal, not a timed contract.

nms.name: Dune Widow
nms.hint: Native spider NM. Hunt Giant Spiders in its region; the drop is not guaranteed.

nativeQuests.name: Chocobos Wounds
nativeQuests.task: Bring 4 Gausebit Wildgrass. Accept from Brutus; feed the nearby Chocobo one grass at a time. Follow the feeding scenes and waits.

nativeQuests.name: In Defiant Challenge
nativeQuests.task: Accept from Maat. Bring Exoray Mold, Bomb Coal and Ancient Papyrus from Crawlers Nest, Garlaige Citadel and Eldieme Necropolis.

nativeQuests.name: Atop the Highest Mountains
nativeQuests.task: Accept from Maat. Check the ??? near Boreal Hound, Coeurl and Tiger in Xarcabard for the three Frigicite key items. Defeat each guardian first if required; return to Maat.

nativeQuests.name: Whence Blows the Wind
nativeQuests.task: Accept from Maat. Collect the Orcish, Quadav and Yagudo crests from the three beastman strongholds; return to Maat.

nativeQuests.name: Riding on the Clouds
nativeQuests.task: Accept from Maat and follow his four NPC clues. Trade one Kindred Seal to each assigned NPC, then return.
